add-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add File Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF and embedding a single file attachment using Aspose.Pdf's FileSpecification and the EmbeddedFiles collection.

attach-file-from-byte-array-to-pdf.title: Embed a Byte Array as a File Attachment in a PDF
attach-file-from-byte-array-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a FileSpecification from a byte array and add it as an embedded file attachment to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Attachments to a PDF
add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed several files into an existing PDF by iterating a list of file paths and saving the updated document.

set-custom-description-for-pdf-attachmen.title: Set Custom Description and MIME Type for PDF Attachments
set-custom-description-for-pdf-attachmen.description: Shows how to iterate over embedded file attachments in a PDF, assign a custom description and appropriate MIME type, and then save the updated document.

list-pdf-attachment-names-sizes.title: List Embedded File Names and Sizes in a PDF
list-pdf-attachment-names-sizes.description: Shows how to iterate the EmbeddedFiles collection of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to output each attachment's name and its size in bytes.

extract-specific-attachment-from-pdf.title: Extract Specific Attachment from PDF
extract-specific-attachment-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate an embedded file by name in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write its contents to a target folder.

extract-pdf-attachments-to-subfolders.title: Extract PDF Attachments to Separate Subfolders
extract-pdf-attachments-to-subfolders.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its EmbeddedFiles collection, and writes each attachment into its own subfolder under a base output directory.

remove-pdf-attachment-by-index.title: Remove PDF Attachment by Index
remove-pdf-attachment-by-index.description: Shows how to delete an embedded file from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by converting a zero‑based index to the library's 1‑based collection and saving the result.

delete-pdf-attachment-by-filename.title: Delete PDF Attachment by Filename
delete-pdf-attachment-by-filename.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate an embedded file by its name, delete that attachment using Aspose.Pdf, and save the updated document.

extract-pdf-attachment-metadata.title: Extract PDF Attachment Metadata to JSON
extract-pdf-attachment-metadata.description: Shows how to read embedded file attachments from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, gather properties like name, size, MIME type, and output them as a JSON file.

update-pdf-attachment-description.title: Update Attachment Description in PDF
update-pdf-attachment-description.description: Shows how to load a PDF, change the description of the first embedded file (attachment), and save the document with the updated metadata.

add-attachment-to-password-protected-pdf.title: Add Attachment to Password-Protected PDF
add-attachment-to-password-protected-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a user password, embed a file attachment, and re‑encrypt the document while preserving the original passwords and permissions.

extract-attachments-from-encrypted-pdf.title: Extract Attachments from Encrypted PDF
extract-attachments-from-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open an encrypted PDF with a password, decrypt it, and extract any embedded file attachments to a specified folder.

validate-attachment-size-before-adding-t.title: Add Attachments with Size Validation to PDF
validate-attachment-size-before-adding-t.description: The example loads an existing PDF, checks each file's existence and size against a defined limit, and embeds only those files that meet the size requirement using Aspose.Pdf's FileSpecification and EmbeddedFiles collection.

batch-add-attachment-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Attachment to Multiple PDFs
batch-add-attachment-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of PDF files and embed the same attachment into each document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-pdf-attachments-to-zip.title: Batch Extract PDF Attachments to ZIP Archive
batch-extract-pdf-attachments-to-zip.description: Iterates over all PDF files in a folder, extracts any embedded attachments, and stores them in a single ZIP archive with unique entry names.

create-pdf-portfolio-with-attachments.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded File
create-pdf-portfolio-with-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF Portfolio using Aspose.Pdf, embed a file as a FileSpecification, and set basic metadata before saving the document.

add-word-document-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Word Document to PDF Portfolio
add-word-document-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to load or create a PDF portfolio and embed a Word (.docx) file as an attachment using the Document.Collection.Add method.

insert-excel-into-pdf-portfolio.title: Insert Excel Workbook into PDF Portfolio with Custom Description
insert-excel-into-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed an Excel workbook into a PDF portfolio and assign a custom description using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-image-into-pdf-portfolio.title: Embed Image into PDF Portfolio with Display Name
embed-image-into-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to create a PDF portfolio, embed an image file as an attachment with a custom display name, and save the resulting PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-nested-pdf-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Nested PDF to an Existing PDF Portfolio
add-nested-pdf-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to embed a PDF file as a nested item inside a PDF Portfolio collection using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiple-files-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Multiple Files to PDF Portfolio
add-multiple-files-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates embedding various file types into a single PDF portfolio using Aspose.Pdf with a single loop.

compress-pdf-portfolio-with-optimization.title: Compress PDF Portfolio Using Optimization Options
compress-pdf-portfolio-with-optimization.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF portfolio, apply optimization settings to compress embedded images and remove unused objects, and save the compressed portfolio.

extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF Portfolio
extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.description: Loads a PDF portfolio and extracts all embedded files, recreating any folder hierarchy encoded in the file names, into a specified output directory.

extract-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.title: Extract Embedded Portfolio File by Index
extract-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate an embedded (portfolio) file by its zero‑based index, and save it to disk preserving the original file name and extension.

remove-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.title: Remove Embedded File from PDF Portfolio by Index
remove-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF portfolio, validate an index, and delete an embedded file using Aspose.Pdf. The updated portfolio is then saved to a new file.

delete-outline-items-by-text.title: Delete PDF Portfolio Items by Description
delete-outline-items-by-text.description: Shows how to locate and remove embedded files (portfolio items) from a PDF by matching their description text, then save the cleaned document.

reorder-pdf-outline-items.title: Reorder PDF Portfolio Attachments
reorder-pdf-outline-items.description: Shows how to change the order of embedded files in a PDF portfolio by removing all items and re‑adding them in a new sequence using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-custom-visual-template-to-pdf-port.title: Apply Custom Visual Template to PDF Portfolio
apply-custom-visual-template-to-pdf-port.description: Loads an existing PDF portfolio, adds a light‑gray background rectangle, a centered title, an optional full‑page background image, and optionally attaches an extra file, then saves the modified portfolio.

generate-pdf-page-thumbnails.title: Set Thumbnail for PDF Portfolio Items (API Not Supported)
generate-pdf-page-thumbnails.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF portfolio, iterating its embedded files, loading a thumbnail image, and shows that assigning a thumbnail to embedded files is not currently supported by the Aspose.Pdf API.

merge-pdf-portfolios-preserve-metadata.title: Merge Two PDF Portfolios Preserving Embedded File Metadata
merge-pdf-portfolios-preserve-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to combine two PDF portfolios into a single document while copying all embedded files and retaining their original metadata.

create-pdf-portfolio-embed-files.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded Files
create-pdf-portfolio-embed-files.description: Demonstrates converting a regular PDF into a PDF Portfolio by embedding multiple files using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-pdf-portfolio.title: Flatten PDF Portfolio to Standard PDF
flatten-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to load a PDF portfolio, remove its collection, flatten interactive elements, and save the result as a regular PDF file.

read-pdf-metadata-attachment-count.title: Read PDF Metadata and Attachment Count
read-pdf-metadata-attachment-count.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract standard metadata fields and count embedded file attachments, then print a concise report.

generate-csv-report-pdf-attachments.title: Generate CSV Report of PDF Attachments
generate-csv-report-pdf-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to enumerate embedded files in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieve each attachment's name, size, and description, and export the information to a CSV report.

add-in-memory-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add In-Memory Attachment to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-in-memory-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into an existing PDF directly from a MemoryStream without creating temporary files on disk.

attach-remote-file-to-pdf.title: Attach Remote File to PDF as Annotation
attach-remote-file-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates downloading a file from a URL into memory, creating a file specification, and embedding it in a PDF as a file‑attachment annotation using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf-with-error-ha.title: Add Attachments to PDF with Missing File Handling
add-file-attachment-to-pdf-with-error-ha.description: Demonstrates how to embed files as attachments in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while handling missing source files gracefully.

validate-attachment-mime-type-and-add-to.title: Validate MIME Type and Embed Attachment into PDF
validate-attachment-mime-type-and-add-to.description: The example verifies that the supplied MIME type matches the file's extension before adding the file as an attachment to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

measure-pdf-attachment-performance.title: Measure Performance of Adding, Extracting, and Removing PDF Attachments
measure-pdf-attachment-performance.description: Demonstrates how to add an embedded file to a PDF, extract all embedded files, and remove them while timing each operation for performance analysis.

embed-attachment-metadata-into-pdf.title: Embed Attachment Metadata into PDF Document Information
embed-attachment-metadata-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a file attachment to a PDF and store its details as custom entries in the document information dictionary using Aspose.Pdf.

add-unicode-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Unicode Attachment to PDF and Verify
add-unicode-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file with a Unicode display name into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then verify the attachment's name.

extract-pdf-attachments-sha256-hash.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF and Compute SHA‑256 Hashes
extract-pdf-attachments-sha256-hash.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its embedded file attachments, and calculates a SHA‑256 hash for each attachment to verify integrity.

add-image-watermark-to-pdf-attachments.title: Batch Watermark PDF Attachments
add-image-watermark-to-pdf-attachments.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its embedded files, adds a text watermark to each PDF attachment, and replaces the original attachment with the watermarked version before saving the document.

add-file-attachment-with-retry.title: Add Attachment to PDF with Retry on Network Share
add-file-attachment-with-retry.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF stored on a UNC network share and implement a retry mechanism for transient I/O errors.

extract-pdf-attachments-in-parallel.title: Extract PDF Attachments Concurrently
extract-pdf-attachments-in-parallel.description: Shows how to load PDF files with Aspose.Pdf, enumerate their embedded files, and write each attachment to disk while processing multiple PDFs in parallel.

verify-pdf-size-increase-after-adding-fi.title: Verify PDF Size Increases After Adding Attachment
verify-pdf-size-increase-after-adding-fi.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and confirm that the resulting PDF file size is larger than the original.

test-attachment-removal-updates-collecti.title: Remove Embedded File and Verify Attachment Count
test-attachment-removal-updates-collecti.description: Demonstrates adding an attachment to a PDF, removing it, and asserting that the EmbeddedFiles collection count updates correctly using Aspose.Pdf and NUnit.

embed-hidden-xml-metadata-pdf-attachment.title: Embed Hidden XML Metadata as PDF Attachment
embed-hidden-xml-metadata-pdf-attachment.description: Demonstrates how to create an XML metadata document, convert it to a stream, and embed it in a PDF as a hidden file attachment annotation using Aspose.Pdf.

add-attachments-to-pdf-and-save.title: Add Attachments to PDF and Save to Output Folder
add-attachments-to-pdf-and-save.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, embedding files as attachments, and saving the modified document to a specified output directory.
